comment: ADR 0005 R19 survival fixture for M1 (NFC identity). Pre-M1 hashed UTF-8 path bytes as stored, so NFC and NFD of one name were different UUIDs. Post-M1 derive(nfd) == derive(nfc) == the new id. Caches keyed by old_uuid — thumbnails, widget JSON, library_cache ids — must be rebuilt from the stored path via migrate_id; this crate does not rewrite them. Release note: thumbnail files named by the old UUID are orphans until the next scan/rebuild.
